description_en: Generates a downloadable inventory of global resources
description_zh: 生成全局资源下载清单
kebab_example: aliyun config generate-resource-inventory --regions cn-shanghai --resource-types ACS::ECS::Instance --resource-deleted 1 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateResourceInventory

parameters.help_en: The regions where the resources are located. Separate multiple regions with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属地域，多个地域之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: regions

parameters.help_en: The resource types. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型，多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en:
The resource status. Valid values:

1 (default): The resource is retained.

0: The resource is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
资源状态。取值：

1（默认值）：保有中。

0：已删除
parameters.name: resource_deleted
